homeSeo.title: AI Virtual Fitting with HAMDEVA
introParagraphs: HAMDEVA is a digital fashion platform built around AI virtual fitting technology so users can explore many kinds of outfits online. After uploading a face photo or choosing a sample image, users can combine it with a clothing image and generate a result that shows the style naturally from multiple angles. The service is not limited to simple image generation. It connects fashion discovery, cultural outfit exploration, traditional style comparison, and digital styling experiments in one experience. In online shopping and content creation environments, people often cannot try clothing on in person, so virtual fitting gives them stronger visual confidence before making a decision.

Users can upload their own face photo or choose a sample image, apply different outfit styles, and quickly compare the generated results. The flow is designed so people do not need to learn complicated editing tools before they can experiment. It also makes it easier to explore categories that are hard to compare in one place in a typical shopping environment, such as traditional clothing, representative outfits from different countries, modern fashion, and concept looks. That makes the experience useful not only for entertainment, but also for understanding which mood, silhouette, and styling direction fits the user best.
homeSeo.whyBody: Virtual fitting technology is becoming an important tool in online fashion environments. Users can evaluate styles without physically wearing the clothes and can explore a broader range of fashion and cultural outfits. It also helps brands, content creators, and educational platforms publish more explanatory content, which strengthens SEO. A user may search for a specific clothing style or cultural garment, arrive at HAMDEVA through that content, and then continue directly into an interactive fitting experience. That combination of search-friendly information and hands-on functionality is one of the core values of the service.
homeSeo.exploreBody: HAMDEVA lets users experience traditional clothing and a wide range of fashion styles through AI image composition. Users can compare country-specific traditional outfits, classic styles, modern fashion moods, and distinctive concept looks in one place while searching for an image that suits them. When rich text explanations and a real try-on experience are offered together, search engines are more likely to recognize the page as a topic-centered content page rather than just a tool page. The HAMDEVA homepage acts as that first entry point by clearly explaining what AI virtual fitting is and why it is useful.

modal.title: Global Traditional Clothing Guide

overview.title: A content-first traditional clothing platform
paragraphs: HAMDEVA is designed as more than an image generator. It introduces users to traditional clothing from multiple regions and then lets them test garments through AI virtual try-on.
This structure makes the platform useful for travelers, students, fashion researchers, families planning portraits, and anyone curious about how cultural dress looks on a real person.
By combining educational content with a practical try-on tool, HAMDEVA helps people move from quick curiosity to informed visual understanding.

technology.title: How the try-on pipeline works
paragraphs: The system starts with a portrait image to keep the same face identity and overall appearance across the result. A clothing image is then used as the strongest reference for silhouette, color, trim, and surface detail.
Instead of generating four unrelated images, HAMDEVA asks the image model for one wide 1x4 fashion sheet. That keeps front, left 45-degree, right 45-degree, and back views more visually consistent.
This approach is more useful than a single front image because traditional garments often depend on side volume, sleeve shape, ribbon placement, or back drape.

cultural.title: Traditional clothing as living design
paragraphs: Traditional garments are not only historical objects. They remain part of celebrations, ceremonies, tourism, performance, identity, and modern design reinterpretation.

HAMDEVA currently highlights garments such as Hanbok, Kimono, Qipao / Cheongsam, Saree, Ao Dai, Chut Thai, Kebaya, Baju Kurung, Baro't Saya, Deel, Kaftan, Agbada, Huipil, Kilt, Dirndl, Flamenco dress, and Bunad.
Showing these clothes in one platform encourages comparison, respect, and broader awareness of how different cultures express beauty through structure, color, movement, and material.

future.title: Fashion technology with context
paragraphs: AI tools can make fashion easier to explore, but technology is most useful when it supports understanding rather than replacing it. Strong reference images, good prompts, and clear cultural context all matter.
A better digital fashion experience does not only produce attractive pictures. It helps users compare garments, preview silhouettes, and make more confident choices before purchase or rental.
HAMDEVA treats AI as a visual support layer for cultural fashion discovery, not as a substitute for craftsmanship, tradition, or expert fitting.

how-it-works.title: How It Works
how-it-works.description: See how HAMDEVA turns a portrait and clothing reference into one coordinated try-on result.

sections.heading: Step 1 – Upload a face photo
paragraphs: Choose a clear portrait with visible facial features and balanced lighting.
The system uses this image to keep the same identity across the final result.

sections.heading: Step 2 – Select a traditional garment
paragraphs: Pick a clothing image that clearly shows the full design, color, trim, and silhouette.
The stronger the garment reference, the more faithful the generated outfit usually becomes.

sections.heading: Step 3 – Generate one 1x4 result sheet
paragraphs: HAMDEVA requests one wide image that contains front, left 45-degree, right 45-degree, and back views.
This single-call approach improves consistency and makes comparison easier.

fashion-technology.title: Fashion Technology
fashion-technology.description: Understand how AI imaging supports cultural fashion discovery and visual decision-making.

sections.heading: Technology with reference discipline
paragraphs: Good virtual try-on depends on clear input hierarchy: the person image guides identity and the garment image guides clothing fidelity.
Without that discipline, generated fashion quickly becomes inconsistent or generic.

sections.heading: Why one combined sheet matters
paragraphs: A single 1x4 output behaves more like a lookbook page than four unrelated renders.
That makes it easier to judge proportion, back drape, sleeve shape, and overall garment continuity.

about.title: About HAMDEVA
about.description: Learn what HAMDEVA does, why it exists, and how the platform combines AI fitting with rich cultural fashion content.

sections.heading: What HAMDEVA is building
paragraphs: HAMDEVA is an AI virtual fitting platform built to make outfit exploration faster, easier, and more visually convincing. The service is centered on one practical question: how will this clothing actually look on a person before purchase, rental, travel, or content production?

Rather than acting like a simple image toy, HAMDEVA combines fitting generation with structured content. Visitors can move from sample outfits, guides, and cultural references into an actual try-on flow without losing context.

sections.heading: Why the content layer matters
paragraphs: Many users do not just want a generated picture. They want to understand silhouette, styling mood, fabric impression, and the cultural meaning behind a garment. HAMDEVA is designed to support that deeper reading of fashion.

This matters even more for traditional dress, because users often need explanation alongside visualization. A stronger content layer helps people choose better references, interpret the result more accurately, and approach cultural garments with more respect.

sections.heading: How HAMDEVA uses AI fitting
paragraphs: The platform takes a face image as the identity anchor and a clothing image as the outfit reference, then generates one coordinated 1x4 fitting sheet. That structure makes it easier to compare front, angled, and back views in one place.
The aim is not to replace real fitting or craftsmanship. The aim is to reduce uncertainty, increase visual confidence, and help users make better styling decisions before they commit time or money.

sections.heading: Where the platform is going
paragraphs: HAMDEVA is being shaped as both a tool and a content destination. Over time, the goal is to make the service more useful for everyday outfit previews, sample look exploration, cultural fashion education, and community feedback.
In short, HAMDEVA is not only about generating an image. It is about helping people understand clothing more clearly and decide with more confidence.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Understand how HAMDEVA handles uploaded images and AI processing.

sections.heading: Uploaded images
paragraphs: User images are used to process the requested try-on result.
HAMDEVA does not present the service as a permanent personal photo archive.

sections.heading: Processing and storage
paragraphs: Images may be transmitted for AI processing, but the service is intended to avoid long-term personal photo storage as part of normal use.
Users should avoid uploading sensitive images they do not wish to process through an AI service.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Review the core terms, privacy principles, and support information for using HAMDEVA in one place.

sections.heading: User responsibility
paragraphs: Users must upload images they have the right to use and should avoid unlawful, abusive, or misleading content.
The try-on output is AI-generated visual content and should be understood as a synthetic preview.

sections.heading: Content and copyright
paragraphs: Do not upload copyrighted or personal material without permission.
Users remain responsible for how they use generated outputs in public, commercial, or editorial contexts.

sections.heading: Privacy and image handling
paragraphs: Uploaded images are used to generate the requested fitting result and related service functions. HAMDEVA is not intended to operate as a permanent personal photo archive.

Users should avoid uploading highly sensitive material they do not want processed through an AI-based image workflow. The service is designed around fitting generation, not long-term storage of personal source images.
